Li: Yeah, I hear you. I found a few bugs in the latest build, but I think we can squash them before the deadline. 

Sarah: Great, I'll take a look at those bugs after I finish testing this feature. 

Li: Sounds good. Let me know if you need any help with testing. 

Sarah: Will do. By the way, have you checked in your changes yet? 

Li: Not yet, I wanted to make sure everything was working smoothly first. I'll push my commits soon. 

Sarah: Perfect, let's aim to have everything merged and deployed by tomorrow afternoon. Sound good? 

Li: Agreed, let's get this done. We've got this!
